name: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: 3DGS represents a scene as a set of anisotropic 3D Gaussian primitives. Each primitive is defined by position, opacity, rotation, scale, and spherical harmonic coefficients for view-dependent color.
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting predicts 3D Gaussian primitives directly from images via a neural network, offering instantaneous novel view synthesis without iterative optimization.
